title: edits/_study corpus entry
description: One studied edit (a TikTok/Reels download, an AirDropped clip, or a screen recording of one) and what the engine learned or could learn from it. Stage 1 of overnight-improve-video-edit-e (N1) seeds this with the historical entries the six existing styles were already built from, each marked learned:historical so they do not count toward N1's new-learning minimum. A later pass adds learned:new entries once a studied reel has actually arrived (gates G1/2998a8b4, G3/791496f9 in out/plan.md), and learned:designed for anything built by extrapolation rather than measurement.

id.description: short slug, first 6 chars of the source filename or hash where the creator's own handle is unknown

source.description: path (if local, under the gitignored edits/_source/ or edits/_study/raw/) or creator handle/title; raw footage is never committed or published

learned.description: historical: already built into an existing style before this build; new: from a reel studied during this build; designed: extrapolated, not measured from a studied edit

style_learned.description: the engine style folder this entry fed, or null for material (like the sfx reels) that fed the sound-effect library instead of a style

cut_rhythm.description: measured cut rate/gaps, in prose with numbers

evidence.description: repo-relative path(s) this entry's facts were taken from
